title: Slow of speech before the true Word
english: While Moses was still [[trained in all the wisdom of the Egyptians >> Bible:Acts 7:22]], he was neither [[slow of speech nor slow of tongue >> Bible:Exodus 4:10]]. Once he heard God’s voice, he felt his speech thin and his tongue hindered; before the [[Word that was in the beginning with God >> Bible:John 1:1]] he names himself mute. A rational man looks eloquent beside mute beasts, mute beside the learned, and — before divine Wisdom — a beast, as David said: [[I became as a beast before you >> Bible:Psalm 73:22]]. Beside the divine Word every human tongue is dumb.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: God opens the mouth; the devil opens another
english: Because he advanced to self-knowledge — the greater part of wisdom — God rewards him: [[I will open your mouth and teach you what to say >> Bible:Exodus 4:12]]. Blessed are they whose mouth God opens. [[Open your mouth wide and I will fill it >> Bible:Psalm 81:10]]; Paul asks [[utterance in the opening of my mouth >> Bible:Ephesians 6:19]]. The contrary is fearful: the devil opens mouths for lies, scurrility, [[idle words >> Bible:Matthew 12:36]], and blasphemy — as [[Satan entered Judas >> Bible:John 13:27]]. [[Discernment of spirits >> Bible:1 Corinthians 12:10]] is itself a gift; [[test the spirits >> Bible:1 John 4:1]]. God likewise opens ears and eyes — Isaiah’s ear, Hagar’s well, the eyes of Elisha’s servant to the mountain full of horses and chariots.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: Aaron meets Moses on God’s mountain — Homilia III CLOSEOUT
english: [[Aaron met Moses on the mountain of God >> Bible:Exodus 4:27]] — the mouth God opens belongs to whoever can meet there. Unless you climb the spiritual sense of the Law, you have not met Moses on that mountain, and God has not opened your mouth. When Moses and Aaron enter to Pharaoh they say: [[Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness >> Bible:Exodus 5:1]] — not serve while still in Egypt’s dark business, for [[no one can serve two masters >> Bible:Luke 16:13]]. Leave the world in mind, not merely in place; [[do not love the world >> Bible:1 John 2:15]]. The [[three days’ journey >> Bible:Exodus 3:18]] marks the way. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.
